platforms.note: Translation: 'This simulator works exclusively with a virtual reality headset (not supplied).' VR is stated only for VR Transfu, which the same page marks 'Non commercialisé actuellement' (not currently sold); it uses an HTC Vive or Vive Pro headset tethered to a computer ('Relié à' 'ordinateur'), supplied by partner Matts Digital. The catalog also lists 'VR CCI' and 'PSY VR', whose names suggest VR but have no description on the pages read. The platform for the rest of the catalog (Collection Infirmière, Collection Aide-Soignante, SIMDOSE dose-calculation software, and others) is not stated; no page says browser, online, desktop app or mobile. The menu shows 'mySimforhealth' and 'MedicActiV' login links with no description. Status is unclear because the only explicit platform statement covers one product that is not currently sold.
